children: Gene-editing stocks fell Wednesday after Anthropic's Claude AI model identified an enzyme system with characteristics similar to technology used to alter DNA.

Beam Therapeutics (BEAM), CRISPR Therapeutics (CRSP), Intellia Therapeutics (NTLA) and Prime Medicine (PRME) were among the companies trading in focus as investors assessed the potential implications for gene-editing research.

Anthropic said Claude found the system by analyzing a broad database of DNA sequences. Scientists at the company provided the initial prompt and carried out laboratory work afterward, with limited involvement in the discovery process itself.

The newly identified system has not yet been fully characterized. Anthropic said its characteristics resemble other programmable systems that can perform functions such as cutting, copying and pasting DNA.

The finding represents the first reported discovery from Anthropic's new wet lab and highlights its effort to apply AI to scientific research. The company said it disclosed the work early to illustrate Claude's research capabilities.

title: Anthropic AI Discovery Gene-Editing Stocks Falling
